claim: At least 10 paper trades are closed by 2026-10-10
basis: 2 entries in the first 14 h would make ~24 a week, but day one is one burst from two sources and a mint cannot re-enter while open.

claim: Closed paper trades stand between 8 and 45 on 2026-10-17
basis: Point estimate 22. Low end if Trump's capitalised words stop landing on active coins, high end if gifts to the ANSEM wallet keep passing.

claim: The leg reaches its 40 closed trades by the give-up date
basis: At even a third of the day-one rate 40 arrives in November. The misses: X credits run out, the sensor is down, or the operator halts on a KILL.

claim: The readout shows KILL at some point before the give-up date
basis: At a 28 % win rate a run of 10 losers inside 40 trades is about a 30 % event on its own; G3 and G4 at 40 trades add most of the rest.

claim: The leg meets S1 (survives on paper) on its first 40 closes
basis: Needs mean net > 0 from entries I believe are mostly not touches at all.

claim: Mean net over the first 40 closes is zero or negative
basis: Random entries, 2.5 % fee, stop booked at -30 %: expectation about -0.09 SOL a trade.

claim: Win rate over the first 40 closes is between 13 % and 40 %
basis: Point estimate 27 %. 40 draws at 0.28 has a standard deviation of 7 points.

claim: Cumulative net over the first 40 closes is between -7.5 and +0.5 SOL
basis: Point estimate -3.6 SOL: 40 trades at -0.09, per-trade spread about 0.45 because a rare +0.9 winner sits beside -0.325 stops.

claim: At least half of the first 40 closes exit on the stop
basis: Passes are by construction the coins that are moving; a -25 % excursion inside 24 h is the usual fate of one.

claim: At least half of the first 40 closes were entered from a Truth Social post
basis: Trump posts dozens of times a day in capitals and every capitalised word is searched; the wallet feed needs someone to send a gift.

claim: Cumulative realised net is below zero on 2026-10-10
basis: Already -0.325 with one position open at +2 % peak; a week of entries at negative expectation rarely digs out.

claim: The screen passes 10 % or less of what it screens through 2026-10-17
basis: 3 of 36 so far. Most resolved names are dead coins with zero buys an hour.

claim: Rejected touches lose less per touch than passed ones, once there are 8 first touches a side
basis: The non-obvious one: if true the breadth screen is selecting volatility, and its 'survivors' are the coins most likely to stop out.

claim: At least one passed touch trades 10x above entry within 24 h before the give-up date
basis: This is the contract's own hypothesis ('moves by an order of magnitude'). It needs a genuine touch to be caught and to pass.

claim: At least one passed touch doubles within 24 h by 2026-10-31
basis: ~30 first-touch passes at 7 % each is an 89 % event; marked down because 7 % is itself a guess.

claim: The X feed produces at least one paper entry by 2026-10-17
basis: 74 X posts, 5 resolved, 0 passed in 14 h; the names X resolves are large caps (PENGU, USELESS, STONK) that fail on buys or market cap.

claim: Median source-to-seen latency on X is 10 s or less through 2026-10-17
basis: 5.4 s on the filtered stream so far; the miss is the stream dropping to the polling fallback.

claim: Operator review of the first 20 paper entries finds fewer than 5 genuine touches
basis: 0 of the first 2. Label each entry from its event text: did the person deliberately name, buy or accept this coin?

claim: RI-01 is superseded by a new contract id before its give-up date
basis: If B4 holds the fix is a touch-intent rule, and that needs a new id and a fresh paper count.

claim: At least 10 RI-02 paper trades are closed by 2026-10-10
basis: RI-01 entered twice in its first 14 h. The 15-minute cut closes most positions inside the hour, so a mint can re-enter sooner; same feeds, same screen.

claim: RI-02 reaches its 40 closed trades by the give-up date
basis: At a third of the day-one rate 40 arrives in November. Misses: X credits run out, the sensor is down, or the operator supersedes again.

claim: The readout shows KILL at some point before the give-up date
basis: A tight stop buys small losses with a low win rate. At ~15 % wins, 10 losers in a row (G1) is better than even inside 40 trades, and G3 (win rate < 25 %) and G4 wait at 40.

claim: RI-02 meets S1 (survives on paper) on its first 40 closes
basis: The mean-loss bar is now met by construction (a stop costs 0.175), so S1 turns only on mean net > 0 and a 25 % win rate, with entries that are mostly not touches.

claim: Mean net over the first 40 RI-02 closes is zero or negative
basis: Smaller losers, but also fewer survivors to reach +100 %, and the entries are the same non-touches.

claim: Win rate over the first 40 RI-02 closes is between 3 % and 28 %
basis: Point estimate 15 %. A winner must hold above -10 % at 5 s marks, be above entry at 15 minutes, and still finish above the 2.5 % fee.

claim: Cumulative net over the first 40 RI-02 closes is between -5.5 and +0.5 SOL
basis: Point estimate -2.8: about 34 losers at ~0.11 and 6 winners at ~0.15. The floor is 40 stops at 0.175 = -7.

claim: Mean loss over the first 40 RI-02 closes is 0.15 SOL or less
basis: A stop costs 0.175 and a 15-minute cut costs 0.025 to 0.125. With a third or more of losers leaving by the cut the mean lands near 0.11.

claim: At least half of the first 40 RI-02 closes exit on the price stop
basis: The 15-minute cut takes the flat ones first; the stop takes what falls 10 % inside 15 minutes or after surviving the look.

claim: At least 30 % of the first 40 RI-02 closes exit on the 15-minute cut
basis: Most entries are coincidental string matches on coins nobody is rushing into (MADE moved under 3 % in 10 h): flat or slightly down at 15 minutes.

claim: At least half of stopped RI-02 passes trade back above entry within 24 h, once 8 stops exist
basis: This is the price of the tight stop. Shadows mark every 5 minutes, so they stop later than the live book and understate it.

claim: Cumulative realised net of RI-02 is below zero on 2026-10-10
basis: Needs only one more loser than the winners cover in the first week.

claim: RI-03 makes at least one paper entry by 2026-10-17
basis: In 36 h the feeds produced 1 intent-bearing touch that reached the screen (rejected) and 0 signed buys; the screen passes about 1 in 10.

claim: At least 3 RI-03 paper trades are closed by 2026-10-31
basis: Roughly 5 intent touches a week reach the screen at the observed rate, about 1 in 10 pass: 2 entries in four weeks is the point estimate.

claim: RI-03 reaches its 40 closed trades by the give-up date
basis: It would need the intent-touch rate to be ten times what 36 hours showed. The roster, not the stop, is the constraint.

claim: The readout shows KILL at some point before the give-up date
basis: KILL before 40 closes needs 10 losers in a row; the leg probably does not reach 10 closes.

claim: Cumulative realised net of RI-03 is below zero on 2026-10-31
basis: About 0.7 that anything has closed by then, and about 0.7 that what closed nets negative under a -10 % stop.

claim: The X feed produces at least one RI-03 paper entry by 2026-10-31
basis: X is where tickers and mints are posted (the one intent touch so far came from it); Truth Social posts carry names, which no longer trade.

claim: At least half of stopped passes in the what-if book trade back above entry within 24 h, once 8 stops exist
basis: The what-if book still follows every screen pass, intent or not, so it keeps scoring the -10 % stop. 5-minute marks stop later than the live book.

claim: RI-03 is superseded by a new contract id before its give-up date
basis: Two contracts were superseded on their first day. The likeliest trigger now is the entry rate: a leg that cannot reach a verdict invites a wider roster or new feeds.

claim: RI-04 market: news-matched pump.fun launches (a launch named after a headline of the last hour) arrive at 30 or more a day over the first week
basis: PumpPortal showed ~10 launches a minute (14K a day) on 2026-10-23; the hour's terms number 100-300 proper nouns; Jack Duval's book is full of headline names (Tesla SpaceX, Official Slumdog Millionaire), which says launchers name coins after the news constantly; the match rule is whole-word, so most launches miss

claim: RI-04 market: at least 70 % of news-matched launches sit under $10K market cap at the create message over the first week
basis: a fresh curve is 28-38 SOL of market cap ($3-4K at $105); only a dev buy over ~60 SOL or a non-standard curve (the 722-SOL croc dog seen in the probe) starts above $10K; mayhem and non-pump pools are screen fails too

claim: RI-04 reaches 40 closed paper trades by 2026-10-31
basis: at 30+ matched launches a day with 70 % under $10K and a 60 s hold, the book of 3 turns over many times a day; the only way to miss is the rate (the market forecast) or a feed outage

claim: RI-04 win rate at 40 closes is 45 % or more
basis: his edge-era scalps won 61 %, his bleed-era scalps 41 %; a symmetric +20/-20 exit with a 60 s cut and 2 % round-trip cost needs about 52 % to break even; the book is the first outside buyer on some launches, which he usually was not

claim: RI-04 mean net per trade at 40 closes is above zero
basis: B9 as written: the loop paid him for nine months and then stopped paying him; honest fills take about 2 % a round trip; the time exit at 60 s books whatever the mark is, so a flat tape loses the fees

claim: RI-04 mean loss at 40 closes is under 0.45 SOL (the S1 bar at 1.5 SOL)
basis: a -20 % stop on 1.5 SOL is 0.30 SOL plus impact and fees, about 0.35; losses beyond the bar need the curve to gap more than 30 % between two 2-second marks, which happens on dev dumps

claim: RI-04: half or fewer of the first 40 closes are stops (the rest are takes and 60 s time exits)
basis: his losers' median was -19 % at about a minute, right at the stop, so many losers will leave by the clock a hair above -20 %; a fresh curve with no buyers after the dev sits flat and leaves by the clock at about -2 %

claim: RI-04 is never KILLed by G1-G4 before 2026-11-30
basis: G1 (10 losers in a row) is the live risk on a 50/50 loop with a 60 s clock: the probability of a 10-run inside 200 trades at p=0.5 is about 9 %, and at p=0.4 about 25 %; G4 (mean net at or below 0 at 40) is the complement of the mean-net forecast

claim: RI-04 reaches S1 (survives on paper) at 40 closes
basis: needs mean net above zero (0.4) and mean loss under 0.45 (0.75) and no KILL; the product of the two main conditions is about 0.3

claim: RI-04 population: by 2026-10-31 the replay of news-matched launches under the contract exits has a higher mean net than unmatched launches, with the 90 % bootstrap interval of the difference above zero (the hour's news carries the edge)
basis: Jack's narrative words split winners from losers in his own book (dog, crypto, united states up; cat, bull, official, trump down) but a Google News proper noun is a coarse proxy for what his names come from; a fresh pump curve with no buyers is flat for both groups, so the difference rides on whether headline names draw the first buyers

claim: RI-04 population: by 2026-10-31 the 'entry +2 s (first mark)' fork has a mean net at least 0.02 SOL below the control (the message-time fill flatters the book)
basis: the live book fills on reserves read ~0.5 s after the create message; a real transaction lands a slot or two later, after the first snipers; on a fresh curve each early 1-2 SOL buy moves the price 3-5 %, so the first mark should sit a few points above the message state
